title: Volkstelling 1960 public use files (beveiligde 1%-steekproeven uit de microdata)
authors: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (primary investigator)
contributors: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (data collector)
descriptions: Reconstruction of the Census of 1960, anonymised 1% samples from the microdata files. Selected variables: sex, age according to 5-year classes, marital status, household position, religious denomination, country of birth, economic status, level of educational attainment, occupation.
